name: Refit
summary: Near-black split hero with a tall interior photo, light Manrope type, line-icon service accordion and sticky case-study cards that scale back as the next arrives.

fonts.pairing: Manrope 500 with slight negative tracking for headlines, Manrope 400 body, small dark pill badges as labels

signature: sticky stacked case-study cards that shrink to 0.9 scale as the next card scrolls over, alternating light grey and near-black
service accordion with thin line icons next to a large image that swaps per item
imagery: moody AI-rendered kitchens and bathrooms, warm plaster interiors, garden paths, small round client avatars
layout_grid: 1440px canvas, 80px side padding, 100 to 150px section rhythm, 4-column stats, 10px radii
